state.description: Complete modernization and replacement of obsolete equipment and relays for the 500kV, 230kV, and 115kV yards. Add a redundant relay scheme at Fortson.

q.instructions: Is this OpenStreetMap substation the endpoint the filing names?

criteria.true: Same facility: the name matches and the operator, voltage and area are consistent with the project.
